images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame beyond the in-game monitor: a full-screen curved CRT terminal with a dark olive plastic bezel filling a 16:9 landscape frame. Green P31 phosphor text glowing with soft bloom, visible scanlines, a faint rolling refresh band and barrel-distorted edges with vignette. Left two-thirds: a scrolling hacker log of port scans, a progress bar reaching 64 percent, and intrusive red-pink ghost lines with slight chromatic aberration answering the player's commands. Right third: a minimalist wireframe network map with nodes, one node marked in red as occupied by the ghost, a red packet travelling along a dashed link. Bottom strip: the core mechanic, a large command line where the typed part glows bright green and the remaining characters are dim, directly under it the ghost's red counter-command being typed, and two racing progress bars. Top HUD with a big countdown timer. Korean UI text: "블랙게이트 관제 서버", "남은 시간 03:47", "역추적 62%". Moody, tense, crisp monospace typography, cinematic lighting from the glowing screen.

Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame beyond the in-game monitor: the same curved CRT terminal, but the ghost has seized control and the phosphor has turned blood red and magenta. The whole screen shakes, horizontal glitch slices tear across the image, RGB channel splitting, heavy scanlines. Center top: a huge red countdown reading 00:09. Left: the player's earlier commands mirrored and reversed as if written by the ghost. Right: a large ASCII-art face made of dithered characters staring out of the screen, breathing. Bottom: a glowing red bordered counter-command box where the player must retype the ghost's command backwards, green typed characters versus a red lock-out meter nearly full. Dark claustrophobic mood, emissive light only from the monitor, crisp monospace type. Korean UI text: "유령이 명령을 되받아쳤다", "역명령", "00:09".
